blocks.text: The 2026 Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) entry “Los Salvajes Bravos” aims to give a voice to the indigenous Filipinos who were taken to Spain in 1887 and displayed as “human exhibits” at the Philippine Exposition. During the film’s media conference on Thursday, Oct. 29, director Paolo Dy said the historical drama was inspired by the experiences of indigenous Filipinos who were recruited to participate in the exposition in Madrid, where they were presented alongside animals, plants and other products. Dy said the production initially explored the history of human zoos in the United States, particularly the one in St. Louis, […]...
